summary: Lane C, one row: ep 17 'Wish' (苦悶, 2002-02-06). Its composition is now settled on three independent lineages. The episode is MAJORITY RECAP - en-WP says 'the series' events regarding Kamui are recapped' and links [[Clip show]]; TheTVDB's German text, attributed to the broadcaster Animax, reads 'Rückblick: In dieser Episode wird erzählt, was bisher in der Geschichte geschehen ist'; its French text reads 'Cet épisode est majoritairement un résumé des précédents' and its Portuguese 'Principalmente um episódio flash back'; the x1999/xtvclamp fandom episode page marks 13 of its 21 listed characters '(flashback)' or '(memory)'. Its closing beat - Kakyo making Kotori appear in Kamui's dream to embrace him and tell him her death was not his fault - is ANIME-ORIGINAL (fandom, Kotori Monou: 'This scene did not take place in the manga, although the last part overlaps with her and Kakyo's goodbye'; en-WP's vol-14 summary has the Kakyo/Kamui dream with no Kotori in it). But the episode's spine IS a manga scene: Kakyo entering Kamui's dream and questioning his wish, Kamui answering that he will bring Fuma back with the Sacred Sword, is en-WP's volume-14 FIRST beat, and Fuma telling Kakyo he will grant his wish to be killed is vol 14's fourth beat - first-time source material, not a cameo. Under T27/T28 that is source + non-source in one episode with both shares story-carrying: ep 17 is MIXED, not plain canon (AFL's 'Manga Canon' is the coarse binary, and AFL/AFG are one source). One refinement to the stored batch-19 fact: ep 17's Kakyo-and-Hokuto dream is the SAME scene already animated in the 2001 OVA prologue 'An Omen' (episode 0, not one of our 24 rows) per TheTVDB's French text and en-WP's ep-0 summary, so the vol-15 ch 63 / bonus 70.5 part of the stored 'rearranged {54-62, 63, 70.5}' is RE-SHOWN material, never first-time coverage. Ep 17 remains position-less: the A44 ruling (Sean 2026-08-27) is untouched by the retype and no anchor is delivered.

anchor_hostile.why: A44 ruling STANDS (Sean 2026-08-27, ANCHOR_SUPPRESSED [9,10,16,17,18]) and the retype to mixed does not disturb it. The row is a recap frame carrying out-of-order fragments: vol 14's Kakyo/Kamui dream (ch 54-62) plus a re-shown ep-0 OVA scene (vol 15's opening, ch 63 / bonus 70.5) plus an anime-original coda. Any END would sit BEHIND ep 16's vol-16 material and AHEAD of eps 18-19's vols 13/15, so no truthful continuous position exists; the tie is carried by the stored 'rearranged' annotation, refined below. Implication of the ruling for this ask: mixed is a STANDING, not a position - ep 17 shows the reader ep 15's/ep 19's anchored positions, never a chapter of its own (A1/A44).

annotations.note: REFINEMENT of the stored batch-19 fact 'eps 17 rearranged {54-62, 63, 70.5}'. The first-time source material in ep 17 is volume 14 only: Kakyo entering Kamui's dream and telling him he can bring Fuma back with the Sacred Sword though he has already seen the fight's outcome (en-WP vol 14, beat 1) and Fuma telling Kakyo his wish to be killed will be granted / not granted if the future changes (vol 14, beat 4). The Kakyo-and-Hokuto dream ('she invited him to go see the sea') and the shooting that put him in the coma - i.e. the vol-15 opening (ch 63) and the vol-15 bonus ch 70.5 - are the SAME scene already animated in the OVA prologue 'An Omen' (ep 0, 2001-08-25 DVD): TheTVDB's French per-episode text says so explicitly ('S'en suit la même scène entre Kakyô et Hokuto que celle de l'épisode zéro') and en-WP's ep-0 summary carries both beats. Re-shown pages are never cited as coverage ('pages, not numbers', Sean 2026-08-27), so 63 and 70.5 should be labelled re-shown rather than adapted at ep 17.

type_corrections.note: T27/T28: source + non-source in one episode, both shares story-carrying. SOURCE share (first-time): the episode's spine is volume 14's opening beat - Kakyo enters Kamui's dream, challenges his wish, and Kamui answers that he will fight to bring Fuma back with the Sacred Sword (en-WP List of X chapters, vol 14: 'In a dream, Kakyō tells Kamui he will be able to bring Fūma back with the Sacred Sword although he already saw what would be the fight's outcome'), plus the Fuma/Kakyo exchange over Kakyo's wish to be killed (same volume). This is the episode's own plot, not a quoted fragment, so T28's 'original plot quoting a fragment = filler' branch does not apply and the row is NOT filler (its standing in the source is non-zero). NON-SOURCE share (substantial): (a) a long clip-show recap - en-WP 'the series' events regarding Kamui are [[Clip show|recapped]]'; TheTVDB DE (Animax) 'Rückblick: In dieser Episode wird erzählt, was bisher in der Geschichte geschehen ist'; TheTVDB FR 'Cet épisode est majoritairement un résumé des précédents'; TheTVDB PT 'Principalmente um episódio flash back'; the fandom episode page lists 13 of 21 characters as (flashback)/(memory) and its blurb reads 'Kamui drifts through a haze of recollections'; (b) the re-shown ep-0 Kakyo/Hokuto scene; (c) the ANIME-ORIGINAL climax - Kakyo makes Kotori appear in the dream, she embraces Kamui and tells him her death was not his fault and the future is undecided ('This scene did not take place in the manga', x1999/xtvclamp fandom, Kotori Monou; en-WP's vol-14 dream contains no Kotori, and the manga's Kotori dream farewell is with KAKYO, not Kamui). So the episode is neither plain canon (AFL's binary 'Manga Canon' cannot see a recap-plus-original-coda structure, and AFL/AFG are one source) nor filler. No anchor follows: ep 17 is ruled A44 position-less.

structure.notes: SOURCE IDENTITY (re-checked, unchanged): the source is the manga X (CLAMP, Kadokawa, 18 volumes + the uncollected Shumatsu III block), chapter space = MangaDex's 1-95 with one '.5' bonus per volume from v5; vol 14 = ch 54-62, vol 15 = ch 63-70. WIKI IDENTITY - NEW AND WORTH RECORDING: xtvclamp.fandom.com and x1999.fandom.com are MIRRORS, not two wikis. Diffed this pass: 'Wish (episode)' and 'Kotori Monou' are byte-for-byte the same wikitext on both (same infobox, same 21-name character list, same 'This scene did not take place in the manga' sentence). Batch 17 cited xtvclamp and batch 19 cited x1999 - those are ONE source, not two, and no future verdict should count them as independent. NEW SOURCE FOUND for this series, which had none per-episode: TheTVDB's X page (series 'X -エックス-', WOWOW, aired-order S1) carries SEVEN per-episode language descriptions, several from broadcasters (the German ones are credited '(Text: Animax)') and the French ones are beat-by-beat plot logs far more detailed than en-WP. Episode 17 is joined by TITLE-less DATE (TheTVDB's own title field is empty; its 'Originally Aired February 6, 2002' + network WOWOW + position 17 match our row exactly, R20 - date join, not index). This is a usable per-episode content source for the remaining X rows if the series is ever revisited. ROW SPACE: en-WP's episode table opens with an EpisodeNumber = 0 entry, the OVA 'An Omen' (予兆, direct-to-DVD 2001-08-25) - it is NOT one of our 24 rows (components: anilist 156, 1-24) and must never be counted into the numbering; it matters here only because ep 17 re-shows its Kakyo/Hokuto material.

flags_for_sean: THE ASK, ANSWERED: ep 17 = MIXED (was: canon). Three independent lineages on the non-source side (en-WP's clip-show wording, TheTVDB's Animax/French/Portuguese texts, the fandom's flashback-marked character list) and en-WP's volume-14 summary on the source side. The apply action is EPISODE_TYPE_OVERRIDES 17:'mixed' alongside the existing 21-24 filler entries. Confidence: high on the composition, high on 'not plain canon'; the residual judgement is mixed vs filler.

THE FORK, stated honestly: if you read the recap as the episode's plot and the vol-14 dream as a transplanted beat inside it, T28's fragment branch would make ep 17 FILLER + a mandatory graft/partial annotation on ch 54-62. I did not take that branch because the vol-14 Kakyo/Kamui dream is not quoted inside an original plot - it IS the episode's frame, start to finish, and the recap footage plays INSIDE that manga scene (Kakyo 'shows Kamui everything that has happened up to this point'). Zero standing in the source is what filler requires, and the standing here is non-zero and structural. If you prefer filler, the annotation to carry is graft {54-62} and the stored 'rearranged' fact would need re-labelling.

ANNOTATION REFINEMENT (supersedes part of the stored batch-19 fact, your call): 'eps 17 rearranged {54-62, 63, 70.5}' should become {54-62} with 63 / 70.5 named as RE-SHOWN from the OVA prologue 'An Omen' (ep 0). Two sources: TheTVDB FR ('la même scène entre Kakyô et Hokuto que celle de l'épisode zéro') and en-WP's ep-0 summary (Kakyo meets Hokuto in a dream, she invites him to see the sea; he is shot foreseeing her death). This is a one-source-per-language TVDB claim corroborated by en-WP's OVA summary, so it is a proposal, not a repair I would force.

SOURCE HYGIENE for the X file: xtvclamp.fandom.com == x1999.fandom.com (mirrors, diffed byte-for-byte). Batch 17's 'xtvclamp + Wikipedia + cbr.com' and batch 19's 'x1999 + Wikipedia' therefore rest on the SAME wiki; nothing in the stored anchors changes because of it, but the two should never again be counted as two.
Nothing else touched: rows 9/10/16/18 (A44), the ep-15 and ep-19 anchors, the ep-20 A8/V10 rulings and all continues are outside this ask and are unchanged.
